symptom: diag loop-report over a ~20 h agent session listed every `run wait` (189), `run restart` (150), `run stop` and `run status` call as UNCLOSED with 0.0s total, and blamed 'a process that vanished: killed', although they exited normally and `run wait` alone accounted for over an hour.
file: cmd/mxcli/exit_process.go exitProcess; cmd/mxcli/cmd_run.go, cmd/mxcli/cmd_run_lifecycle.go (os.Exit → exitProcess); cmd/mxcli/diag_loop_report.go help. Test: cmd/mxcli/exit_process_2360_test.go
cause: runCLI closes the diagnostic session (session_end with duration and exit code) when the root command returns; the run verbs left through os.Exit inside their Run funcs — on exit code 0 too — so no session_end was written.
insight: **Instrumentation that lives on the return path misses every os.Exit, including the successful ones.** The earlier fix (closing on the error path) assumed os.Exit meant failure; the lifecycle verbs use the exit code as their API and exit 0 through os.Exit. Route exits through one helper that closes the session, and keep a source test on the files that must not call os.Exit. Measured after: run status (exit 3) and run stop (exit 0) each write session_end; loop-report shows 0 unclosed. 271 other os.Exit sites in package main remain.
